  • Field Details

    • P

      public double P
      Main component of PID, Proportional, the bigger it is the faster the PID is, if too big it overshoots and if too small it doesn't reach the setpoint

    • I

      public double I
      Integral component of PID, if the PD doesn't reach the setpoint increase this together with IZone to make have a little push at the end to reach the setpoint

    • D

      public double D
      Derivative component of PID, increase this to make the PID smoother, it's job is to lower the speed of the PID if it spikes too much

    • IZone

      public double IZone
      IZone is the error zone to enable the I component, for example, if you work in meters and your PD doesn't work after error of 0.1m you can set this to 0.15

    • V

      public double V
      Wanted velocity to voltage feedforward

    • A

      public double A
      Wanted acceleration to voltage feedforward

    • S

      public double S
      How much voltage to overcome static friction

    • G

      public double G
      How much voltage to overcome gravity

    • gravityType

      public com.ctre.phoenix6.signals.GravityTypeValue gravityType
      Whether the gravity on the subsystem is like an elevator or line an arm. This will only affect kG if you gave it a number

    • cruiseVelocity

      public double cruiseVelocity
      the max velocity the profile should reach

    • acceleration

      public double acceleration
      the acceleration in which the profile should increase its velocity until cruise velocity reached

    • jerk

      public double jerk
      the rate of acceleration change in the profile

    • type

      public ControlConstants.ControlType type
      Which control scheme these constants apply to; set automatically by the createXxx factory methods below.

    • createPID

      public static ControlConstants createPID(double P, double I, double D, double IZone)
      Builds plain PID constants (control type ControlConstants.ControlType.PIDF, no feedforward terms).
      Parameters:
      P - proportional gain
      I - integral gain
      D - derivative gain
      IZone - error zone below which the integral term is active
      Returns:
      the new ControlConstants

    • createPIDF

      public static ControlConstants createPIDF(double P, double I, double D, double IZone, double V, double A, double S, double G, com.ctre.phoenix6.signals.GravityTypeValue gravityType)
      Builds PID constants with feedforward terms (control type ControlConstants.ControlType.PIDF).
      Parameters:
      P - proportional gain
      I - integral gain
      D - derivative gain
      IZone - error zone below which the integral term is active
      V - velocity feedforward
      A - acceleration feedforward
      S - static-friction feedforward
      G - gravity feedforward
      gravityType - whether gravity compensation should behave like an elevator or an arm
      Returns:
      the new ControlConstants

    • createProfile

      public static ControlConstants createProfile(double cruiseVelocity, double acceleration, double jerk, double V, double A, double S, double G, com.ctre.phoenix6.signals.GravityTypeValue gravityType)
      Builds open-loop trapezoid-profile constants (control type ControlConstants.ControlType.PROFILE), with no PID feedback.
      Parameters:
      cruiseVelocity - the max velocity the profile should reach
      acceleration - the rate at which the profile accelerates up to cruise velocity
      jerk - the rate of acceleration change in the profile
      V - velocity feedforward
      A - acceleration feedforward
      S - static-friction feedforward
      G - gravity feedforward
      gravityType - whether gravity compensation should behave like an elevator or an arm
      Returns:
      the new ControlConstants

    • createProfiledPIDF

      public static ControlConstants createProfiledPIDF(double P, double I, double D, double IZone, double cruiseVelocity, double acceleration, double jerk, double V, double A, double S, double G, com.ctre.phoenix6.signals.GravityTypeValue gravityType)
      Builds trapezoid-profiled PID constants with feedforward (control type ControlConstants.ControlType.PROFILED_PIDF) - PID feedback correction layered on top of a motion profile, similar to CTRE Motion Magic.
      Parameters:
      P - proportional gain
      I - integral gain
      D - derivative gain
      IZone - error zone below which the integral term is active
      cruiseVelocity - the max velocity the profile should reach
      acceleration - the rate at which the profile accelerates up to cruise velocity
      jerk - the rate of acceleration change in the profile
      V - velocity feedforward
      A - acceleration feedforward
      S - static-friction feedforward
      G - gravity feedforward
      gravityType - whether gravity compensation should behave like an elevator or an arm
      Returns:
      the new ControlConstants
